# Recommended Implementation Approach

Implement an **in-memory only architecture with encrypted transit** where PII is processed exclusively in RAM using secure enclaves or memory-protected processes, never persisted to disk. Combine this with **audit logging of all PII access events** (without storing the PII itself) to a write-once, tamper-evident log, and use **temporary memory buffers with cryptographic erasure** that are overwritten immediately after processing. This satisfies the no-disk-storage constraint [ctx_0001] while providing the clean auditability [ctx_view_0002] the team requires.
